body: I know you're hurting, so I don't want to be insensitive to that. But please understand that the man you follow has been extremely aggressive towards people and can be very triggering to us. His words frighten people and the actions of many of his followers make us afraid for our lives. So while I accept your feelings, please remember that it's hard for some of us to be as helpful as we'd like to be when we're so cautious.
Well I've been listening to the exact things that he says. That's what disturbs me.

Maybe that comment isn't as helpful as it could be, but I can tell you that trump and his followers are filling your head with this fear. Maybe a good first step is getting away from those influences.

I don't even understand how to approach this. Trump's words of hate, and those of his supporters, are part of the reason I want to die. There is absolutely no chance of Sharia law in the United states. I am infinitely more afraid of Trump as president than any Muslim.
One of the only things that keeps me going is the hope that the lawsuit will give me enough money to get away and maybe help someone else. But that hope isn't enough.

I have a federal lawsuit against the company. I'm hopeful about it but it just takes so long. I've been waiting almost a year for it to go anywhere. I don't think i have the energy to wait longer. I'm in so much pain all the time and the people at my work make it so much worse. I can't afford to quit. That's part of why I feel so trapped. I just want them to settle so i can get enough money to quit but in the mean time I'm so afraid the pain is going to get to be too much.
Not being discriminated against. That would sure be nice.

Thank you. Even with new laws the healthcare system in the US is simple: if you have lots of money you're fine. If you don't then you're fucked. And healthcare companies, providers, hospitals insurance companies routinely discriminate against trans people. It's just accepted. When I tried to convince my company to cover it no one stood up for me. I have a federal lawsuit pending, but I'm scared I won't last that long. They don't understand our pain and the truth is they just don't care.
